result.summary: tZERO Group, Inc., a financial technology company powering tokenized financial markets through regulated Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) solutions, and FG Imperii Acquisition Corp. (Nasdaq: FGII), a publicly traded special purpose acquisition company, today announced the confidential submission of a draft registration statement on Form S-4 to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
result.title: tZERO and FG Imperii Acquisition Corp. Announce Confidential Submission of Draft Registration Statement on Form S-4 in Connection with Proposed Business Combination

result.summary: tZERO’s qualified custody technology will support regulated assets held by institutional investors using NAVRA, with compliance rules governing the approval and release of every transfer in near real time.
result.title: NAVRA and tZERO Partner to Bring Real-Time Collateral Mobility to Qualified Custody
